tools.name: search_clubs
tools.description: Search approved golf clubs/courses in Spain (Canary Islands first, mainland Spain being added). Returns summary records (last_verified; no sources[]); call get_club or list_sources_for for provenance before citing.

tools.name: get_club
tools.description: Get one approved club by UUID or slug, with all facts, sources[] (max 200; sources_truncated: true if cut) and club_facts: what the club itself published from its verified account (green fee, visitor rules, booking link, hours, buggies, dress code, languages), or null.

tools.name: list_sources_for
tools.description: List provenance (source URL, publisher, trust level, field, retrieved_at) for a club (max 200; sources_truncated: true if cut).

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_club" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Get one approved club by UUID or slug, with all facts and sources[] (max 200; sources_truncated: true if cut)." → after: "Get one approved club by UUID or slug, with all facts, sources[] (max 200; sources_truncated: true if cut) and club_facts: what the club itself published from its verified account (green fee, visitor rules, booking link, hours, buggies, dress code, languages), or null."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
